source.title: The Frigid Barrow
source.description:
Just as life springs forth from decay, so too may the unnatural come to serve the natural.

The heart can be made into a stave of shifting form, but I will need a vessel strong enough to contain its power.

There is a barrow den near Starfall Village, in Winterspring. The true entrance will only reveal itself if you are alone.

Within is a keeper who lost his way long ago; Nandieb. His stave shall be the heart's vessel. It pains me to suggest, but he is no longer the great keeper I once knew.
source.objective: Find Nandieb in the barrow den near Starfall Village in Winterspring, and recover his stave. This must be done alone.
source.completion:
The chromatic heart, and Nandieb's stave: Together, they will form the shifting staves Gla'sir and Rae'lar. Two objects of malice and destruction, transformed in service of creation and life.

I bestow this power unto you, <name>, in the hope that you will continue to prove a noble steward of all life across Azeroth.
